  <div>
    <h1 class="atlas-headline">Analytical chemistry, Shiny apps, and R tools for language models.</h1>
    <p class="atlas-lead">
      I'm a research scientist and analytical chemist at a large chemicals R&amp;D organization. Outside the lab, I spend a lot of time building open-source R and Python packages around analytical data, Shiny, and AI agents. Click around the map below to see what I've been working on, or detour past the dogs and cats.
    </p>

::: {.content-visible when-format="llms-txt"}
# James H. Wade

Research scientist and analytical chemist at a large chemicals R&D organization building open-source R and Python developer tools for scientists.

## Active Open-Source Projects

- **Analytical chemistry:** [measure](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure), [measure.sec](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure.sec), [measure-methods](https://github.com/JamesHWade/measure-methods), and [van-deemter-lab](https://github.com/JamesHWade/van-deemter-lab).
- **Shiny and interfaces:** [shinymcp](https://github.com/JamesHWade/shinymcp), [rill](https://github.com/JamesHWade/rill), and [suppose](https://github.com/JamesHWade/suppose).
- **R packages for AI agents:** [deputy](https://github.com/JamesHWade/deputy), [dsprrr](https://github.com/JamesHWade/dsprrr), [tempest](https://github.com/JamesHWade/tempest), [scans](https://github.com/JamesHWade/scans), and [graft](https://github.com/JamesHWade/graft).
:::
